tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus 'khor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzod du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya/ satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ snying gar hūṃ nag po las don yod grub pa nag po/ lte bar hoḥser po las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/

gsang bar k+ṣaḥsngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rnams 'khod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaṃḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrā ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarba ā ba ra ṇa dharmā pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kā yi ka bigh+nāṃ bi nā ya ka ā dī nāṃ/ da sha dig ga tā nāṃ/ kā ya wāka tsit+tā ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhasmi ku ru ku ru huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs 'don no/ / bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa dang*/ de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// srid gsum skye 'jigs med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ / dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mā le mā la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a mri te ṇe wi t+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya was+t+ra a bha ra ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya ghaṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra wa d+ye ba d+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye nṛ t+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra kā me sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ kro dha a dī naṃ/ badz+ra sū ra ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog pa yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi//bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ oṃ shūn+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/

de thams cad kyi steng dang 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du maṃ las ri rab lhun po'o/ /de'i steng du k+ṣaṃ las sna tshogs chu skyes lte ba pad+ma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du haṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcas pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las zhes pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams snga ma bzhin du grub par gyur/ lhun po'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la bh+ruṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ kun nas dwangs shing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing*/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a i ṛ u l̥/ a er o al/ ha ya ra ba la aṃ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor dang*/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā aḥzhes pa rnams g.yas skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ l+la y+ya ḍ+ḍa l+la y+ya s+sa ṣ+ṣa t+ta d+da n+na/ p+pa ph+pha m+ma/ ḍ+ḍa ṇ+ṇa/ ts+tsa tsh+tsha dz+dza k+ka kh+kha g+ga gh+gha zhes pa rnams g.yas skor dang*/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ྈྐ sha ṣa ྉྤ sa/ ha ya ra ba la/

ḍha ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon bskor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku'i yongs su rdzogs pa haṃ yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnam 'gyed cing*/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga dang*/ lcags kyu g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas/ drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ bdud kyi dga' ma dang*/ drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo ba med par gnas pa/ sku mdog sngon po g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can mdun zhal nag po mche ba phyed gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ste/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/

spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang*/ rdo rje rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje mgul rgyan dang*/ rdo rje gdub bu dang*/ rdo rje ska rags dang*/ rdo rje rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ /de rnams re re la'ang phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gugadamar po bzhis/ mda'/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhis/ 'khor lo/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ dgra sta rnams 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga kha phye ba/ khrag gis gang pa'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhis/ dung*/ me long*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa pad mas spras pa 'dzin zhing*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bde ba'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum ser mo/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad ma/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nub zhal gtso bor bzhag pa lta bur mdun zhal ser mo/ g.yas zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/

bgrang phreng rnams 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ rin po che rnams 'dzin pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril zhing*/ des kyang snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ mer du ba ma/ bden bral du smig rgyu ma/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma/ rlung du mar me ma/ de rnams kyi zhal gyi kha dog ni g.yas bskor gyis/ bung ba'i mdog can nyin byed lta bu gser dang rnam par dkar ba'i mdog /pad+ma rā ga gser gyi mdog mtshungs rab dkar in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs/ /kun+da'i mdog can shin tu dkar min dmar po mchog gi gser dang mtshungs/ /ka ra ke ta 'dra zla ba'i dpal 'dzin gnag dang nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od/ / de bzhin du phyag mtshan ni/ nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan+dan gur gum dang ni ga pur snod/ /dril bu pad+ma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdu bu ste/ /g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen rna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas ma 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras chan snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍa ma ru/ /pi wang rnga dang 'khar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud/

/'di dag gi rgyab tu yang grwa bzhir/ chos kyi dung dkar po/ chos kyi gaṇ+ḍī dmar po/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu nag po/ dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid las 'phros te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang log nas slar rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te/ a yig las byung ba'i mi skyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa 'i bar 'og gi rdor sems dang 'dra ba la rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/ de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor lo dang bcas pa gyur/ oṃ su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen po bcug par gyur/ de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying gar rab tu zhugs te/

byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyi reg pa'i sems can de rnams/ mchog gi dga' ba dang*/ bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid/ zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang*/ de dag re re zhing skad cig gis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ k+ṣa k+ṣi

k+ṣu k+ṣl̥ las phung po lnga rnams rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang*/ k+ṣā k+ṣī k+ṣū k+ṣl̥̄ las khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang*/ k+ṣa k+ṣe k+ṣar k+ṣo k+ṣal k+ṣaṃ las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang*/ k+ṣā k+ṣā+ai k+ṣār k+ṣā+au k+ṣāl k+ṣāḥlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang*/ k+ṣ+la las/ las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang*/ k+ṣ+lā las/ las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te/ slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs su gsol/ lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dhū tī'i lam du hoḥyig dag dang*/ dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las byung ba'i zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/ hoḥyig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/ gtum mo shes rab kyi chags pas yab yum gnyis nus ma brgyad dang bcas pa zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ de nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lha mo rnams kyis 'di skad du/ sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa po/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis bdag cag bsrung du gsol/ /lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa ste/ /'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod/ /ces bskul bas/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga dang*/ de las byung ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan zhing*/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo/ sna tshogs yum gyi 'khyud pa'i sku gyur pa dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la nus ma brgyad/

phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi la/ rdo rje bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis bzhengs pa gyur pa ni/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal pa'i phyag gi pad+ma stong pa drug dang me yi tshogs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma sreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma ru/ /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang*/ /dril bu phub dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos rgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje'i sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'khyud gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la bdud/ / nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan+dan gur gum dang ni ga bur snod/ / ces pa nas/ mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud/ /tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen bsgrub dga' ba bzhis/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa/ /skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi// chos kyi dung dang gaṇ+ḍī nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te/

aṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'khyud pa/ nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar rang nyid la bdag por bzhugs par gyur/ de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ nam mkha'i khams su spros te/ ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ khro bo'i dbang po slar yang rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhū paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai waṃ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wā t+yaṃ/ badz+ra nri t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥhi/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpral bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sku rdo rje/ mgrin par raḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa la/ gsung rdo rje/ snying gar aṃ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje/ de rnams rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa rnams 'khod pa las rab tu spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/

sku'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje dang thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pas bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar gyur/ dpral par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyi ni/ / byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed= /sku yi= /byin rlabs= / de nyid/ gsung dang thugs la'ang 'don pa spo'o/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ shes rab kyi lte bar hoḥlas sku rdo rje/ gsang bar swā las gsung rdo rje/ gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la a yig mi bskyod pa dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la i yig don yod grub pa dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ yig rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la u yig snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la l̥ yig rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la aṃ yig rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ lha rnams kyi lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams su sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams la/

l̥ u ṛ i a'o// lha rnams kyi dpral pa mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dus me'i dkyil 'khor rnams la oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ'o/ /rdo rje nor bu gzhom du med pa'i a yig go /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sregs shing*/ /spyan ma mig la sogs pa dag /sregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag/ yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas so/ /oṃ dz+nyā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ slar yang mas brtan pa'i dga' ba bzhi sku bzhi dang 'bras bu bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra satwa haṃ durdān+ta da ma ka huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs kyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ dus kyi 'khor lo shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i sngags/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes pa bye ba bzlas pas bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / yang na oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pa'am/ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hṝṃ hrūṃ hrāḥswāhā zhes pas kyang bsnyen pa'o/ / mthar oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs bcu gnyis kyis gong bzhin mchod par bya'o/ / mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ / sogs 'dud nyi shus bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs kar thim/ de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad par gang yang rung ba brjod nas thun mtshams la 'jug go/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang*/ gtor ma bshams/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i/ oṃ yongs su gyur pa las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/

de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang dmar/ lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du u las dri chu/ nub tu l̥ las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su l̥̄ las glang po che'i sha dbang ldan du ū las ba glang gi sha bden bral du ṝ las rta'i sha me mtshams su ā+-i las khyi'i sha dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dhaḥswa bhā wa sarba dharmān su bi shud+dha swa bhā wan ku ru swāhā/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dhar+m+ma pra bo dha kā sarba dharmān pra bo dha ya swāhā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su/ sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu'i gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa 'bar par gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dhar+m+mā pra dī pa ka sarba dhar+m+mān pra dī pa ya swāhā/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shes rdo rje'o ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoḥsarba dhar+m+ma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmān badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ brjod pa ni/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*/ /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/

oṃ ha hā hi hī badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ṭo ṣa ya/ ṭo ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hṛ da ya huṃ hūṃ phreṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ nas/ kā maṃ gyi bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥshrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa bhī ka ra ya/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he te tsa a ga t+ya sa pa ri wā rāḥ shrī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛ h+nān+tu/ kha dān+tu/ bi bān+tu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛpa tāḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shīn tiṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ/ ā wa ra ṇa/ gub+tiṃ/ kurbān+tu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra/ ādz+nyā pa ya ti swāhā/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ uṣ+ṇ-i ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+na an+ta ka nī la dāṇ+ḍa/ pradz+nyā an+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza/ pad+ma an+ta ka a tsa la/ ya ma an+ta ka mahā bā le bh+yaḥ gri gug gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ ā ka shā/ bā yu/ te dza/ u ta ka pri thi bī/ sā dhi bh+yaḥ ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ prah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu/ nai ri t+ya/ wā yu/ ya ma ag+ni/ sa mu tra/ i shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ rā hu/ kā la/ ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ bu dha/ maṃ ga la/ shu kra/ pṛ has pa ti/ ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥ pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa ka wā su ki/ shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+me bh+yaḥ 'khor lo phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ be tā ḍa/ bi kṛ ta mu kha/ shwā/ kā ka sū ka ra/ gṛ dha/ byā gh+ra/ ū lu ka dzam+bu ka/ ga ru ḍa/ mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes pa rnams kyis mthar/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i dam pa liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā rāḥ ྄shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛ h+ṇān+tu/ kha dān+tu/ pi wān+tu/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛb+tāḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān tiṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ/ ā wa ra ṇa/ gub+tiṃ/ kurbān+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya tī swāhā/ phyi mchod ni/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhī ka rā ya/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsa na maḥ badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nai be d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra wā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo 'dul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ / rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

'dod don gsol ba ni/ sde drug bsrung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang*/ / bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma 'di dag len zhing gsol ba dang*/ /btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis/ /'gro la zhi rgyas bsrung skyob sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ / bar 'dir chos skyong ye shes pa rnams la so so'i gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ ā hūṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ sogs kyis/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang dgos na skabs 'dir gtong*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ mi bskyod rdo rjai ye shes che/ / sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ / sogs kyis 'phrin las gzhol/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*/ /mi'i 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*/ /sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun tu ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig / ces shis pa brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim/ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aṃ yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo dang*/ dpral bar i yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo dang*/ mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo dang*/ snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo dang*/ lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/

bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog sgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyis pad+ma la gtugs shing*/ /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar/ /rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e baṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ /de rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching*/ /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ /dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar drug pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs dang*/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can sogs dang*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / zhes sogs smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab par bya'o/ /zhes pa dus kyi 'khor lo lha dgu'i sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas pa ste/ lam 'di dang chos 'di la mos pa rnams kyi nyams len la shin tu mkho bar mthong zhing 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i dbang byed pa sogs la'ang 'di tsam sgom pa 'khyer bde zhing legs par shes nas tā ra nā thas nye bar sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dus 'khor lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhugs/
